title: ETH AI Center Doctoral Fellowships
about: The ETH AI Center invites applications for its 2027 Doctoral Fellowships in interdisciplinary AI research. Applicants need a relevant Master's degree; at least two references are required, and selected candidates attend an online doctoral symposium in February 2027.
requirements: Master's degree in a relevant field, completed at least three months before the start (latest June 2027)

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Interdisciplinary artificial intelligence research" (record field) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Interdisciplinary artificial intelligence research" (record field) → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
